pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, dark, polygonal regions with irregular, non-linear edges. Edge gradients are moderate, transitioning from dark to light pelage over a small pixel distance.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Narrow, light-colored interstitial pathways forming a continuous topological grid. Intersection nodes are predominantly tri-point or quad-point junctions with relatively uniform thickness.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette visible along the upper neck and shoulder contour against the background.
